description: Consolidate duplicate CanonicalComparator implementations. Found 3 distinct implementations: app/placement/comparator.py (evidence-backed, uses snapshot for block comparison), app/intake/canonical_comparator.py (compares candidate against canonical reference from TypeScript snapshot), and app/agents/canonical_comparison.py (agent handler with RepositoryBlockContract). After analysis, keep app/intake/canonical_comparator.py as canonical (most complete with structural/API/deviation checks). Mark the other two for removal or refactoring to use the canonical version.
steps: 1. Read all three implementations fully to document their unique features: app/placement/comparator.py (lines 1-end), app/intake/canonical_comparator.py (lines 1-end), app/agents/canonical_comparison.py (lines 1-end)

2. Search for all imports of CanonicalComparator across the codebase: grep -r 'from.*comparator import CanonicalComparator' services/project-ai/ and grep -r 'from.*canonical_comparison import CanonicalComparator' services/project-ai/
3. Identify which implementation is most used and has the most complete feature set (preliminary analysis suggests app/intake/canonical_comparator.py is most complete)
4. Create a single canonical implementation in app/placement/canonical_comparator.py (new file) that incorporates all necessary features from the three implementations
5. Update all imports to reference the single canonical implementation
6. Add deprecation comments to the old implementations with pointers to the new canonical location
7. Verify no functionality is lost by running all tests that reference CanonicalComparator
acceptance_criteria: Single CanonicalComparator implementation exists in app/placement/canonical_comparator.py
All imports across the codebase reference the canonical implementation
Old implementations have deprecation notices or are removed
All existing tests pass without modification or are updated to use new import path
ComparisonReport or ComparisonResult dataclasses are unified if duplicated
verification: Run grep 'class CanonicalComparator' services/project-ai/app/ to confirm only one active implementation
Run pytest services/project-ai/tests/ -k 'canonical or comparator' -v to verify comparison-related tests pass
Run full test suite: pytest services/project-ai/tests/ --tb=short to check for regressions
